nextStoryContext: US-008 added emitAttachHint(sessionName, env) to src/logging/screen.ts as the shared helper. It suppresses the hint when isInsideProjectSession(sessionName, env) returns true (CAM_SESSION matches). plan/next/issue all got an injectable env field in their options and call emitAttachHint on their successful path. The unconditional 'Attach with: tmux attach -t ...' muted hints that existed in plan.ts and issue.ts were replaced by the smarter emitAttachHint call (which still emits the tmux attach line as part of the hint, but only when detached). next.ts also had its unconditional 'Attach with:' replaced.
